heading: How today's work feeds the capstone
lead: Today's four parts form the "when to use an agent" gate at the top of your harness. The gate decides whether a job needs an agent, tool, or workflow; it earns no points. In Session 15, your part 4 verdict opens PLAN.md. Practice 02 shares read_file and run_tests through a bounded workspace server using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), then connects synthetic tickets through a second server to a Docker database. run_gradle arrives with the capstone.
